mentions.name: 3D Software Renderer in C
mentions.description: A 3D software renderer written in C as a from-first-principles computer graphics learning project. It implements triangle rasterization, perspective projection, a depth buffer, clipping, texture mapping, diffuse lighting, and gamma correction, with shadow mapping in progress as the final renderer feature before planned procedural generation of meshes and textures. A YouTube video series walking through the code and algorithms is planned.
mentions.problem: Built as a hands-on way to learn more about computer graphics by implementing rendering techniques from scratch.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted to learn more about computer graphics, so I'm writing a 3D software renderer in C. So far I have a solid implementation of triangle rasterization, perspective projection, depth buffer, clipping, texture mapping, diffuse lighting, and gamma correction.
